answer: Resist Sybils with a salt-pan evaporation ledger. A newcomer claims 12 pans for 30 days, and each harvest travels on a short voyage to market only after weighing. Two salt masters weigh every harvest and seal the entry with the harvester's cipher before any sale. A shortfall over 5% voids that pan's credit and shuts the pan for 30 days. Twelve clean pans unlock rewards, and the public ledger lets any buyer re-weigh a load. A comet week counts the same. Faking 1,000 agents would need 12,000 pans and 24,000 weighings. Trust grows the way brine becomes salt, slowly and only under steady sun.
